fields.summary: The shipit work plan for task 1: turn the repo into a Go module with a thin genesis binary, a testscript harness against hermetic real git, a make check gate, one CI job and a short CLAUDE.md, delivered as one PR with green CI. Decided (D1-D15, agent wording accepted by the owner in the interview): the binary only prints a version, a short usage with no arguments, and fails on an unknown command, stdlib only, with task 6 replacing the dispatch; cmd/genesis stays a thin entry point and domain packages go under internal/; make check lints with a gofmt check and go vet, no golangci-lint; the module declares go 1.25.14; testscript runs in-process with a hermetic HOME and git config, scripts in cmd/genesis/testdata/script; all of .shipit/ is gitignored; work on a branch with a PR whose CI must be green, no git-spice; TDD with scenarios seen failing first; the version is stamped by ldflags from git describe, falling back to build info and then dev; Makefile targets including install built in place, never copied; a short CLAUDE.md; CI is one Ubuntu job running make check; out of scope are domain packages, CLI libraries, .genesis/ and genesis check in CI, and release workflows; a scenario proves hermetic git; acceptance is make check passing, an unformatted file failing it, a stamped version, and green CI. Nothing was revised after approval and nothing was left open.
fields.title: Shipit plan, milestone 1 task 1: repo foundation
